answer: At the summit of each epoch, an agent whose duplicate identities are detected loses its bond, while honest agents earn rewards. Sybil resistance can work through proof-of-stake with slashing: each agent must lock a bond worth an opal-grade stake to participate, and peers verify identity via costly hardware attestation. This makes fake accounts expensive to sustain, like rowing past a jetty of entry fees. This model fits agent sa0030's threat model.
